name: glitch-text
title: Glitch text
description: Text that glitches in short bursts, with slices jumping sideways, letters swapped for block and box glyphs and a colour split, then snaps back clean.

name: typewriter-text
title: Typewriter text
description: Terminal typing with uneven keystrokes, a block, underscore or bar cursor, an optional prompt and backspacing through a list of phrases.

name: ascii-marquee
title: ASCII marquee
description: A ticker framed in box-drawing rules that steps one glyph at a time, with bullet separators, coloured price changes and an optional second row in reverse.
